podcast.title: Co-Creator of The Blues Brothers (1980)
podcast.body: John Belushi co-created *The Blues Brothers* TV characters for Saturday Night Live, which were later adapted into the 1980 musical film, featuring Aretha Franklin. "The Blues Brothers, a comic riff on the Saturday Night Live TV characters created by John Belushi and Dan Acroid"

podcast.title: Saturday Night Live Cast Member
podcast.body: John Belushi was a cast member on "Saturday Night Live" when it debuted in 1975, contributing to its showcase of satire and new comedic talent. "Saturday night live, debuts in 1975 and becomes this showcase of satire featuring Dan Acroix, John Balushi, Jane Curtin, Gilder Radner, Chevy Chase."
